text:
Ava (Marketing): Quick heads-up — we have a Firn Health customer story in flight. Need to schedule interview, lock a hero quote, get legal approval, and map out launch + webinar tie-in. Can people confirm availability? :calendar:

Marco (Customer Success): I can do interviews next Tue/Wed morning PST. Prefer Tue 10am if that works for Firn.

Ava (Marketing): Tue 10am PST works for me. Jon, does that line up with the product timeline (we were hoping to align with the benchmark blog)?

Jon (Product): Yes, we can sync. Benchmarks draft will be ready by Mon, so Tue interview is fine. We should confirm embargo window though — want the story to go live same day as the benchmarks/webinar?

Zane (Growth): Ideally: embargo -> publish blog + social + webinar registration open -> sales nurture emails go out. If story + benchmark land same day we can route inbound leads directly to sales queue B (high-priority).

Ava (Marketing): Proposed timeline: embargo until Wed 09:00 PT, coordinated publish at 09:05 PT, webinar scheduled same day at 13:00 PT. Thoughts?

Priya (Legal): I need the raw transcript and the exact quoted text from customer before I can sign off. Also flagging: any mention of specific performance numbers needs a screenshot/appendix with methodology.

Marco (Customer Success): Will get transcript + verified quote. I can ask Firn for permission to include the perf numbers and a short methodology blurb.

Tess (Design): For the hero asset I need a high-res headshot and the company logo with clear usage rights. Marco, can you request a logo SVG from them in the interview?

Marco (Customer Success): Yep — I'll ask for headshot and SVG at the interview. Also requesting a short 1-2 sentence bios for the speaker.

Ava (Marketing): Interview guide (short):
1) Quick intro + role
2) What problem were you solving?
3) Why Redwood (reason they chose us)
4) What changed — metrics or qualitative win
5) Any tips for other teams
6) Quote we can use verbatim (1-2 lines)
Please keep it conversational and try to capture a concise quotable sentence.

Priya (Legal): Minor edit: we can't publish customer revenue or identifiable PII. If they mention specific revenue impact, we'll need an approval email from their legal. Also prefer the quote to avoid superlatives like "best" without context.

Ava (Marketing): Noted. Marco — can you remind the customer not to include PII or non-public revenue numbers? Ask for permission to use any performance percentages.

Marco (Customer Success): Will do.

Zane (Growth): Routing note: once publish happens, inbound leads tagged with "Firn-benchmark" should auto-enrich and go to SDR queue B, then follow up flow #3. @launch-bot can we add that trigger?

launch-bot: Reminder created: On publish of `firn-health-customer-story` tag leads -> SDR queue B. Deploy scheduled for Wed 09:10 PT.

Jon (Product): One more ask — can we include a small "how we measured" box in the benchmark post. Priya, that'll help with Legal.

Priya (Legal): Good idea. If the methodology is short and transparent, I can clear the final copy faster.

Tess (Design): I'll mock up hero + social card by Mon EOD. Will use placeholder imagery until headshot arrives.

Ava (Marketing): OK action items: Marco to run interview Tue 10am PST and deliver transcript + candidate quote within 24h; Tess to produce hero mock; Jon to drop benchmark methodology; Priya to review final copy by Tue EOD; Zane to confirm lead routing trigger; I’ll draft the launch copy and social.

Marco (Customer Success): Confirmed. Also will ask the customer for an optional 30s video clip — good for social snippets if they can record.

Ava (Marketing): Sweet. Can everyone pls mark final signoff deadline Tue 23:59 PT so we can respect Wed morning embargo?

Priya (Legal): I'll aim for Tue 17:00 PT review; if anything major pops I will flag immediately.

Zane (Growth): I'll validate the SDR routing by Tue night.

Tess (Design): Mock by Mon, final assets by Tue noon assuming customer supplies headshot.

Jon (Product): I'll drop the measurement blurb by Mon afternoon.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team. Marco — lmk after the interview and drop the transcript here. :coffee:
